In a couple of years, you’ll become a novice programmer, because your skills will atrophy, and you’ll mindlessly cram and copy everything. Without practice writing proper code, you won’t even be able to debug. Essentially, you’ve become a white-box tester for now, but soon it’ll become a black box for you. You’ll end up where all “vibe coders” end up: writing essays to get code that more or less works. AI slop code is essentially a one-armed bandit that, with a certain probability, spits out an answer that looks like the right one. But the choice is yours. With every new wave of AI madness, we see services that are less and less optimized and secure-and that constantly crash because of the hallucinations of programmers who’ve outsourced their brains and critical thinking to AI.
